params.name: lab
params.description: The ID of the lab for this request.

params.name: account_number
params.description: The lab account number for this request.

params.name: created[gt]
params.description: Return orders created after this Unix timestamp (exclusive).

params.name: created[gte]
params.description: Return orders created at or after this Unix timestamp (inclusive).

params.name: created[lt]
params.description: Return orders created before this Unix timestamp (exclusive).

params.name: created[lte]
params.description: Return orders created at or before this Unix timestamp (inclusive).

params.name: ending_before
params.description: Cursor - an object ID to fetch the previous page.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: Cursor - an object ID to fetch the next page.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of objects to return (1-100, default 10).

items.docs: Returns orders for a lab, sorted by creation date with the most recent orders first. Supports cursor pagination via `starting_after` / `ending_before` and a `created` date interval filter.
Creates an order for a user, either saved as a draft or submitted to the lab. Supports rx, frame, redo, and multi-pair submissions. Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to safely retry.
